name: Conserv — interior shell sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "INT-CONSERV-SHELL-001 — Conserv — interior shell sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Missing construction views behind existing room snapshots; generic substrate plus source-compatible interior faces

INT-CONSERV-SHELL-001-S01 — Glass roof rib bay. Dimensions W,D,H [8, 5, 12]m proposed. One isolated glass roof rib bay, original palace rose and ivory marble, gold trim, blue/rose glass where source appropriate. Show interior face, ceiling/underside and rear wall/roof contact. Real door/window apertures open; furniture/foliage removable. Preserve local room character rather than replacing with one generic hall.
